terms.definition: A converging lens: parallel rays are refracted to meet at the principal focus.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Forms real or virtual images.

terms.definition: A diverging lens: parallel rays spread out as if from the principal focus.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Always forms a virtual image.

terms.definition: An image that can be projected on a screen, where rays actually meet.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. A virtual image is where rays appear to come from.

terms.definition: Opaque objects reflect some wavelengths and absorb others; the colour seen is the wavelength most reflected.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Filters transmit only some wavelengths.

terms.definition: Reflection from a smooth surface in a single direction.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Diffuse reflection from a rough surface scatters light.
